lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Coach!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Coach!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Are you busy?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I have an urgent favor to ask of you.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: You're the only one who can help me.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: That's why I'm reaching out.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Coach?
What is it?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: First of all,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I want to apologize.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I really should be telling you this in person,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: but that's not really feasible for me right now.
It's okay, just tell me what's going on.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Could you help me take care of Rewind for a few days?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Scratch that. It's Clay, to be precise.
Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I'm tied up with some personal matters

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: that have got me temporarily sidelined,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: so Clay is trying to

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: lead the team on her own.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: It seems she's having a rough go of it,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: and the reception from the fans isn't all that great.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Whenever I call her, she says that everything is okay

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: and insists I have nothing to worry about,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: but how can I not?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: What I'm really worried about,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: more so than the team,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: is that Clay may be pushing herself too hard.
All right, don't worry. I'll handle it.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: You will?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Thank you!
Where is Clay now?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: There's a cheerleading event going on today,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: so that's probably where you'll find her.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I'll send you the exact time

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: and location in a moment.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I'm sorry to throw this all in your lap.
If you're really sorry, how about treating me to a meal sometime?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: We can go wherever you like!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I'll buy you anything you want, as long as my wallet allows it!
Bay is taking what was supposed to be a joke seriously, but I just can't bring myself to tell her...
I'll just ask for something reasonable.
Sounds good.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: All right, I'll get in touch with you later.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Thank you so much, Coach!
